info.title: [V-EB05] Primary Melody ｜ ｜ Card List ｜ Cardfight!! Vanguard Trading Card Game | Official Website

cards.text:
V-EB05/001EN
Colorful Pastorale, Sonata
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[Melody]‐[CONT](VC/RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +5000. This is shared by all of your units with [Melody].
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], reveal cards from the top of your deck until a card with [Melody] is revealed, call that card with [Melody] to (RC), and shuffle your deck.

V-EB05/002EN
Colorful Pastorale, Canon
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[Melody]‐[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, you may [Soul-Charge 1]. This is shared by all of your units with [Melody].
[ACT](VC):[COST][Soul-Blast 3], and until end of turn, when your opponent would call guardians from his or her hand, he or she must call two or more at the same time.

V-EB05/003EN
Colorful Pastorale, Serena
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[Melody]‐[AUTO](VC/RC):When it's attack hits a vanguard, if your hand has four or less cards, draw a card. This is shared by all of your units with [Melody].
[ACT](VC):[COST][Counter-Blast 3], and return three cards with [Melody] from your drop zone to your hand.

V-EB05/004EN
Colorful Pastorale, Fina
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[Melody]‐[CONT](VC/RC):This unit gets "Intercept" and "[AUTO]:When it intercepts, this unit gets [Shield] +10000 until end of that battle.". This is shared by all of your units with [Melody].
[ACT](VC):[COST][Soul-Blast 2], and for this turn's battles, your "when attack hits" effects activate even if the attack did not hit.

V-EB05/005EN
Colorful Pastorale, Caro
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[Melody]‐[CONT](VC/RC):This unit gets "Boost" and "[CONT](RC):During the battle it boosted, this unit gets [Power] +5000.". This is shared by all of your units with [Melody].
[AUTO](VC):When placed, [COST][Soul-Blast 2], search your deck for up to one "Colorful Pastorale, Caro", reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

V-EB05/006EN
Top Star, Cier
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[CONT](RC):Your other rear-guards in the same column as this unit cannot be attacked.
[AUTO](RC):When placed, [COST][Soul-Blast 1 & reveal a grade 3 card from your hand], look at seven cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to one card with [Melody] from among them, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

V-EB05/007EN
Diva of Atlantea, Iryna
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 4｜ Power 14000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC):When placed, reveal ten cards from the top of your deck, and if all of the normal units revealed have different card names, at the end of the first battle of this turn, [Stand] this unit. Shuffle your deck.

V-EB05/008EN
Unparalleled Ingenuity, Loura
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 4｜ Power 14000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC):When placed, reveal ten cards from the top of your deck, and if all of the normal units revealed have different card names, call any number of the revealed cards to (RC), and they get [Power] +10000 until end of turn. Shuffle your deck.

V-EB05/009EN
Heart Monopoly, Anezka
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 4｜ Power 14000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC):When placed, reveal ten cards from the top of your deck, and shuffle your deck. If all of the normal units revealed have different card names, acquire one Imaginary Gift: Force, Accel, and Protect in any order.

V-EB05/010EN
Greenness Energy, Salia
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When it attacks and is not boosted, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and until end of that battle, increase or decrease this unit's [Power] to match one of your vanguard's [Power]. (Match the [Power] at that time)

V-EB05/011EN
Blue-Silver Diva, Brume
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):During your opponent's turn, this unit gets [Power] +5000.
[AUTO](RC):When its attack hits a vanguard, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and draw a card.

V-EB05/012EN
Masterly Cover, Minne
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], draw two cards, return a card from your hand to your deck, and shuffle it. If you do not have a rear-guard with the same card name as your vanguard on your (RC), return three cards to your deck instead of one.

V-EB05/013EN
Favored Child Idol, Eno
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[CONT](VC/RC):During the battle it attacked a vanguard, this unit gets [Power] +2000.
[AUTO](RC):When your vanguard's attack hits a vanguard, you may return this unit to your hand.

V-EB05/014EN
Fluffy Wonder, Preenez
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When your deck is shuffled by your card's ability, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

V-EB05/015EN
Rainy Tear, Stezza
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle it boosted a vanguard, [COST][retire this unit], draw a card, then, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & put a grade 3 card from your drop zone on the bottom of your deck], and draw a card.

V-EB05/016EN
Glittery Baby, Lene
Trigger Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO](GC):When placed, [COST][discard a card from your hand], and one of your units cannot be hit until end of that battle.

V-EB05/017EN
Shapely Eyes, Ruhe
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):If you drew a card during this turn by your card's ability, this unit gets [Power] +5000. (Includes [Draw] too. Does not include drive checks and cards that were "put")

V-EB05/018EN
Super Hit Medley, Paterle
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[ACT](VC/RC):[COST][Soul-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn. If this unit is on (RC), then, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and one of your vanguards gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

V-EB05/019EN
Devoted Time, Inasta
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):If you have a grade 3 or greater unit in the same column as this unit, this unit gets "Boost", and can intercept from the back row.

V-EB05/020EN
Friendly High-Touch, Scioltia
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When it attacks, if your opponent called a total of two or more guardians during this turn, this unit gets [Power] +15000 until end of that battle.

V-EB05/021EN
Reverberator, Dies
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):This unit gets [Power] +5000 for each of your grade 3 rear-guards.
[CONT](GC):If you have a grade 3 rear-guard, this unit gets [Shield] +5000.

V-EB05/022EN
Lovable Spontaneity, Voll
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When placed, if you called another rear-guard during this turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of turn.
[CONT](RC):During the battle it boosts, if you have five rear-guards, this unit gets [Power] +5000.

V-EB05/023EN
Admirative Solo, Atri
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[CONT](RC):If you have no other units in the same column as this unit, this unit cannot be chosen or retired by your opponent's card effects. (It can be attacked. It is retired when hit)

V-EB05/024EN
Sugary Lordling, Ravoure
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When it attacks or boosts, if your opponent called a total of two or more guardians during this turn, this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of that battle.

V-EB05/025EN
Equable Career, Spiana
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When placed, you may return a card with the same card name as a grade 3 card on your (VC) or (RC) from your drop zone to your deck. If you returned a card, shuffle your deck, and [Counter-Charge 1].

V-EB05/026EN
Officious Luscious, Thoria
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When the attack it boosted hits a vanguard, [COST][retire this unit], look at the top card of your deck, put it on the top or bottom of your deck, and draw a card.

V-EB05/027EN
Crawl-up Girl, Est
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When placed, [COST][discard a total of two grade 3 cards with different card names from your hand], search your deck for up to one grade 4 card, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.

V-EB05/028EN
Deliberate Bash, Strasica
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 10000
[CONT](RC):If you have a grade 3 or greater unit in the same column as this unit, this unit gets "Intercept" and can intercept from the back row.

V-EB05/029EN
Fixation on Cuteness, Paparla
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[CONT](VC/RC):During your turn, if you have a rear-guard with the same card name as your vanguard on your (RC), this unit gets [Power] +15000.

V-EB05/030EN
Social Fig, Intime
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 12000｜ Shield -
-

Up Up Flight, Rigore
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 10000
-

V-EB05/032EN
Welcome Sing, Ouvil
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):If another rear-guard was called by your card's ability during this turn, this unit gets [Power] +5000.

V-EB05/033EN
Class Session, Ostina
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When it attacks a vanguard, if all of the units on your (VC) and (RC) have different card names, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle.

V-EB05/034EN
Strive Dream, Radue
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC)/(GC):If you have a rear-guard with the same card name as your vanguard on your (RC), this unit gets [Power] +2000/[Shield] +5000.

V-EB05/035EN
Bolstered Elegance, Leshar
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):If your soul has two or less cards, this unit gets [Power] +2000. If your soul has no cards, it gets [Power] +5000 instead of +2000.

V-EB05/036EN
Full of Mischievousness, Sirrah
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 2｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):If your hand has five or more cards, this unit gets [Power] +10000.

V-EB05/037EN
Novice Idol, Piena
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When your vanguard is placed, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

V-EB05/038EN
Self-Management, Ralentesse
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle it boosted a vanguard, if you have no face up cards in your damage zone, [COST][retire this unit], and [Counter-Charge 1].

V-EB05/039EN
Dance Queen, Prach
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 10000
[CONT](RC):If you have five or more cards in your hand, this unit gets [Power] +5000.

V-EB05/040EN
Pure Gifter, Aliche
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO]:When rode upon, draw a card.

V-EB05/041EN
Max Shout, Culie
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO]:When your drive check reveals this card, you may put a trigger unit from your drop zone on the bottom of your deck.

Direct Sign, Pursh
Trigger Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
